status: Proposed operational audit policy within parent-confirmed standing dependency-only rule revision3; exact native acceptance and parent quota clearance still gate publication
trigger: Review each new dependency proposal or changed resolved closure. Keep held proposals as reminders; do not re-run unchanged unsupported proposals merely because main advanced.
audit_before_execution: Resolve complete changed direct/transitive coordinates, artifact variants and effective toolchain scopes; verify official distribution/artifact hashes and source/tag/commit identity.

Inventory actual upstream source differences against previously accepted exact versions. Manually inspect changed exercised entry points, build/install hooks, network/download/authentication, subprocess/native-loader paths, signing/archive and shrinker behavior, and any application data/API/security effect.

Trace new selected artifacts or code paths discovered during resolution before allowing execution; retain exact reviewed hashes and explicit loader/task observations. Do not treat a compatibility page, lockfile diff or tests as upstream source audit.

Use a focused risk-based review, not a claim of exhaustive third-party certification; document unread modules/generated code/native optimizer or inaccessible source. Official source provenance does not prove reproducible binary equivalence.
routine_action: Choose a compatible coordinated maintenance pair within current project/support boundaries; use isolated local changes, applicable tests/analysis/package gates and independent review.
Integrate audited/tested dependency-only updates under saved standing permission without repeated approval prompts. Keep product/storage/food work out of the candidate.

Prepare a monotonic unpublished development candidate through existing trusted signing workflow, verify exact artifacts and all existing native/release gates. Parent coordinates native acceptance and fresh quota before publication.
Stop publication on attributable failure and use reviewed scoped revert/follow-up, preserving build floors, evidence, keys, release assets and all canonical data.
user_decision_exceptions: Confirmed security or user-facing product change, durable-format/history/storage semantics, or substantive architecture/stack change.
Signing/security policy, protection/permissions/credential changes, new external secret access, paid runner/billing changes or user-computer/live-data operations.
Proceeding outside supported compatibility bounds or with unresolved source/provenance/critical behavioral uncertainty instead of keeping update held.
Destructive actions or release scope that exceeds dependency-only standing permission; parent retains exact native/quota/publication coordination.
hold_policy: Retain PR1/2 open without manual reruns/close/merge. Reassess when requested version/source changes, official compatibility/toolchain support changes, an urgent security advisory warrants different risk, or a relevant upstream fix appears. Optional existing blocked labels/tracker consolidation is for parent coordination; no new scheduler or comments created.
limits: Source review is bounded; build success is not security proof. Exact native behavior remains device/API/provider/artifact attributed, and unrun checks stay pending.
